rules.what: reviewed corrections on top of the extractions (a dropped condition, a misread expression)
drop settings whose defining feature is out of scope (multi-agent, state-dependent, ...)
fields added in ontology 0.7–0.8, filled from the extracted text
fields whose unstated value matches no stated one (dueling winner, market mechanism)
regret against a different benchmark (switching, dynamic, foresight) is its own family
against adaptive adversaries, pseudo- and expected regret are not pooled
small-loss and variation bounds form their own regime
a condition fixing a scanned variable (K = 2, d treated as constant) hides its exponent
an instance-dependent O(.) bound without a gap hides a gap-dependent constant
a condition that changes the protocol (quantum oracle, extra feedback) removes the bound
an upper bound for a restricted instance class does not set the rate
an upper bound valid only for small horizons does not set the rate
lower bounds for one algorithm or class (not all / consistent) do not set the rate
a lower bound needing a parameter that grows with T does not set the rate
a violation resting on held instance parameters gets no verdict
equal polynomial rates stated with O~ / Omega~ are a log gap, not tight
every rule above switched off at once
